headline: Synopsys chief executive Sassine Ghazi says AI agents now draft verified chip designs from customer specifications, but fully autonomous chip design is still out of reach.
score_reason: Kept at pool score: a credible industry view, but the executive describes his own company's products.
importance_line: It affects chip engineers and system companies that design their own chips, and it is an executive's own account of his company's tools.
summary: digitimes reports that Sassine Ghazi, chief executive of Synopsys, a leading maker of chip-design software, said at the CEO Summit of SEMICON West 2026 that customers now give system specifications to Synopsys' AI agents, which directly produce verified register-transfer level designs (the code-level description of a chip), but fully autonomous chip development has not yet become reality. He said people must still define architectures and make final sign-off decisions, and that Synopsys announced a partnership with OpenAI at the end of September 2026.
